testimonials.title: Loved by Students
testimonials.subtitle: A few words from students in Kabul

zaac-001.name: Ahmad, Grade 11
zaac-001.content: ZAAC helped me become more confident in English. The teachers explain slowly, give examples, and make every student feel comfortable asking questions.

zaac-002.name: Fatima, Kabul
zaac-002.content: I joined for mathematics and physics, and the classes made difficult topics much easier. The lessons are clear and the environment is respectful.

zaac-003.name: Maryam, English Student
zaac-003.content: My speaking improved a lot after studying at Zahoor Afkaar Academic Center. I like that the classes are simple, organized, and practical.

zaac-004.name: Omid, Computer Class
zaac-004.content: The computer classes helped me learn useful skills step by step. The teachers are patient and explain things in a way students can understand.

zaac-005.name: Zahra, Science Student
zaac-005.content: ZAAC is a good place for students who want to improve in school subjects. Chemistry and biology became much clearer for me here.

zaac-006.name: Haroon, Kabul
zaac-006.content: The center has a calm learning environment. I feel motivated to study English, science, and computer skills for my future.
